Synthetic test document — fictional patient, generated for software testing. Not a real report.

This fixture keeps a limitations paragraph from manufacturing a finding. The limitations
line near the end names, in the singular and inside a negation, a class of variant this
assay cannot see. Read literally that was a result: it produced a phantom record, and
because the record made the list non-empty it also suppressed the "nothing detected"
warning — so a negative report came back with a fabricated finding and no warnings at
all. The plural form escaped only because of a word boundary, which was luck rather than
design. Nothing in this preamble uses the trigger wording, so that the document tests the
guard rather than the preamble.

Harborview Genomic Medicine
CLINICAL EXOME SEQUENCING — REPORT

Patient: Specimen, Testcase T          DOB: 16/04/2017
MRN: 9902311
Date of collection: 12 January 2026
Date of report: 05 February 2026

Reason for referral: Autism spectrum diagnosis, mild intellectual disability.

Test performed: Whole exome sequencing, proband and both parents (trio).

RESULT

No pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants were identified in genes currently
associated with the reported phenotype. This is a non-diagnostic result.

Limitations: this assay does not detect repeat expansion, methylation abnormality,
or deep intronic variation. Copy number changes below the resolution of the pipeline
are not reported. Fragile X testing is a separate assay and was not requested.
